g.text: TERRABOT v2 FIELD ROVER — MECHANICAL LAYOUT
VIEW A: TOP-DOWN PLAN VIEW (CHASSIS & COMPONENT ZONES)
Shows 520 mm overall width clearance within standard 30" (762 mm) crop rows
VIEW B: SIDE PROFILE VIEW (SENSOR ARTICULATION)
Shows 2-DOF optical cup lowering into soil contact with EPDM ambient-light seal
VIEW C: FRONT ELEVATION VIEW (GAUGE & STABILITY)
Transverse section showing low CG (135.5mm) ensuring 58.9° static roll stability
Raspberry Pi 5 (8GB) + Hailo-8L NPU (26 TOPS, IP65 sealed)
AS7265x Triad + Solux 20W Halogen + 99% PTFE shutter + EPDM skirt
u-blox ZED-F9P Multi-Band RTK on 350mm mast (1.4 cm accuracy)
12.8V 20Ah LiFePO4 (256 Wh, 2.5kg) in low belly tray (Z=120mm)
Adafruit RFM95W 915MHz dipole + 4G LTE buffered telemetry backup
4x 12V 120RPM Planetary DC + Encoders (11.8 N·m combined stall)
Motorized lead-screw core auger (0–15 cm) + TrueSoil TDR moisture
